## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm run verify` passes locally
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) and follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] Tests added or updated for anything non-trivial
- [ ] No new dependency, **or** the dependency was discussed in an issue first
      (see CONTRIBUTING.md § Dependencies)
- [ ] No security property rests on frontmatter or on prompt text
- [ ] An ADR was added or updated, if this changes a significant decision
